situations.hidden: Hidden: nothing to show, or the owner is away (docked)
situations.peek: Peek: the pointer rests on the top-edge zone
situations.compact: Compact: work is running and the owner is active
situations.expanded: Expanded: the card is open, no alert
situations.alert: Alert shown: an approval, a question or an error
situations.finished: Finished: the done beat and its hold
situations.sleeping: Sleeping or dozing: floating with nothing live, or the owner away
situations.play: Play reaction: poked, annoyed, dizzy, greeting or a glance
situations.dragging: Dragging: the owner is moving the character
situations.file: File held over it, or the drop choice is open
situations.muted: Hidden by the owner: for an hour, or until tomorrow

events.answered: The shown alert is answered here
events.elsewhere: The shown alert is answered elsewhere, expires or is withdrawn
events.hover: The pointer rests on it for hoverExpand
events.hits: Quick repeated hits on the character
events.file: A file is dragged over it
events.away: The owner goes idle for absence
events.drag: A drag starts on the character

hidden.start: compact, unless the owner is away (then stays hidden; the start joins the return summary)
hidden.phase: stays hidden; the state is kept, nothing is drawn
hidden.alert: expanded on the alert, through absence (in quiet hours: a quiet peek, no sound)
hidden.done: stays hidden; it joins the return summary
hidden.failed: error alert, as an alert arriving
hidden.lost: stays hidden; offline is shown the next time it appears
hidden.file: peek with the drop target open, then file
hidden.return: compact with the return summary when anything happened while away, else stays hidden

peek.phase: peek, the face shows the new phase
peek.lost: peek on the offline face after offlineGrace
peek.hits: expanded (hits count as play only once it is open)
peek.collapse: hidden after peekLeave once the pointer has left the zone

compact.start: compact; the in-sight count grows, focus stays
compact.phase: compact; face and line change with one phase beat
compact.other: compact; only its in-sight entry changes, no motion
compact.alert: expanded on the alert; the face makes the attention move
compact.done: finished; focus moves to the next live work after the hold
compact.lost: compact on the offline face and line after offlineGrace
compact.back: everything is re-read; the true face returns
compact.collapse: no change (compact folds away only when nothing is live)

expanded.start: expanded; a new face joins the in-sight row
expanded.phase: the step track moves on: the new step replaces the last
expanded.alert: alert; the run moves into the in-sight row
expanded.done: finished inside the card; focus moves after the hold
expanded.lost: the card shows offline and greys the last known step after offlineGrace
expanded.back: everything is re-read; the card updates in place
expanded.listen: listening; the card keeps its content under the listening face
expanded.click: play: hit one (poked); a click on a control does that control
expanded.collapse: compact, after the countdown line has run for collapseCountdown

alert.start: the alert stays; the in-sight count grows
alert.phase: the alert stays (its work is waiting on the owner)
alert.other: the alert stays; only the in-sight line changes
alert.alert: queued behind it, in the waiting list's order (consequence, then age); the waiting count pops once
alert.answered: the answer beat (nod for yes, a small shake for no), then the next alert after alertGap, else what was under it
alert.elsewhere: it leaves with an 'answered elsewhere' line for one beat (or `<work>: the request expired` when it expired), then the next alert or what was under it
alert.done: the alert stays; done work joins the in-sight row only
alert.lost: the alert stays; its actions disable with a line saying nothing can be sent
alert.back: re-read: still pending, actions come back; gone, as answered elsewhere
alert.listen: listening holds the alert (never answers it); it returns when listening ends
alert.click: no play during an alert; only its controls act
alert.hits: nothing: no play during an alert
alert.file: the drop is refused while an alert shows
alert.drag: dragging, carrying the alert (a docked alert undocks as a floating one)

finished.start: the beat completes, then the new work shows
finished.alert: the hold ends within one beat; alert
finished.done: the hold extends; the line counts the finished work
finished.failed: the hold ends within one beat; error alert
finished.lost: after the beat, the offline face
finished.listen: the hold ends within one beat; listening
finished.hover: expanded on the finished work, with Open
finished.click: expanded on the finished work, with Open
finished.away: hidden; the work stays in the return summary
finished.collapse: after finishedHold: compact when other work is live, else hidden

floating.start: the face wakes into the working look (no bubble)
floating.phase: the face shows the new phase with one beat
floating.alert: a one-line bubble with the alert badge; a click opens the alert card beside it
floating.done: the done beat on the face, no bubble
floating.hover: a hover card with the line and the in-sight count
floating.click: the card opens beside the character
floating.away: sleeping (dozing: eyes closed, dimmed), never hidden
floating.collapse: the open card closes; the character stays

sleeping.start: the wake beat, then the working face
sleeping.alert: wakes within one beat into the alert bubble
sleeping.done: stays asleep; the work joins the return summary
sleeping.failed: wakes within one beat into the error alert
sleeping.lost: stays asleep with a small offline mark
sleeping.listen: wakes within one beat into listening
sleeping.hover: opens one eye; the line shows on hover
sleeping.hits: play: a startled wake, then floating
sleeping.return: wakes with the return summary in the bubble when anything happened

listening.start: listening stays; the in-sight count grows
listening.alert: queued until listening ends (the waiting count shows)
listening.answered: cannot: alert actions are disabled while listening
listening.done: listening stays; the work joins the in-sight row
listening.lost: listening stays, with the offline mark (transcription will wait)
listening.unlisten: within one beat, the queued alert if any, else what was under listening
listening.click: only Stop acts (it stops the capture); no play
listening.file: the drop is refused while listening
listening.drag: dragging, still on the listening face

play.start: the reaction ends within one beat; the true state shows
play.phase: the reaction ends within one beat; the new phase shows
play.alert: the reaction ends within one beat; alert
play.done: the reaction ends within one beat; finished
play.failed: the reaction ends within one beat; error alert
play.lost: the reaction ends within one beat; offline
play.back: the reaction ends within one beat; the true face
play.listen: the reaction ends within one beat; listening
play.click: the next hit while the reaction still plays: poked, then annoyed, then dizzy
play.hits: escalates to dizzy; after dizzy, hits only blink for playCooldown
play.away: the reaction ends; hidden or dozing
play.collapse: the reaction finishes, then the collapse happens

dragging.start: the face changes on the next frame
dragging.phase: the face changes; no beat until the release
dragging.alert: the badge shows at once; the bubble opens on release
dragging.failed: the badge shows at once; the bubble opens on release
dragging.unlisten: back to the dragged true face

file.start: no change: the drop or the choice stays
file.alert: a held file is refused; an open choice yields to the alert and comes back after it
file.done: no beat while the owner is choosing
file.lost: the drop is refused, or the choice disables, with a line saying why
file.listen: the choice is held; listening; then the choice returns
file.click: a click on a choice does that choice (Ask about it, Add to Knowledge, Put it aside)
file.file: drop: the swallow beat, then the choice; leave: the mouth closes, back to what was under it
file.collapse: the choice closes and the file is put aside: nothing was done with it

muted.start: nothing shows; the tray and dock still tell
muted.alert: nothing shows here; the tray, the dock and notifications still tell
muted.failed: nothing shows here; the other surfaces still tell
muted.listen: the listening face shows: the one thing hiding never hides
muted.hover: nothing (no peek while hidden by the owner)
muted.file: nothing (no drop target while hidden by the owner)

offline.back: everything is re-read; the line says `Connected again`, the true state returns, and alerts that came in show
offline.hover: expanded on the offline card: since when, and Open PersonalClaw
offline.hits: play is allowed (offline is not an alert)
offline.file: the drop is refused: nothing can be asked while offline

hidden.hover: the first peek of a session plays the greeting
